newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Britain to sell three HK vessels to Philippines-TV.
newsitem.headline: Britain to sell three HK vessels to Philippines-TV.

text.p: The British navy is close to sealing a deal to sell three patrol vessels now stationed in Hong Kong to the Philippines and most of the money will go into the territory's coffers, a local TV station reported on Friday.
The three vessels were expected to sail out of Hong Kong for Manila on the last day of British rule, the Pearl television station reported.
Hong Kong, a British colony for more than 150 years, reverts to Chinese rule at midnight on June 30.
"The price for the ships has been tacitly agreed. It has not yet released but it is a very good deal for the Philippines," the station quoted a British navy official as saying.
"Whatever price we finally agree, 75 percent of the cost will go to the Hong Kong government," the official said.
